{{Top|leg}}
A '''V30 landspeeder mixture filter''' was a component used in [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeders]]. It emitted a thick, even spray. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] also used V30s attached to a canister of [[Engine/Legends|engine]] [[Coolant/Legends|coolant]] to create a makeshift diffusion field to deflect [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolts.
